parts.name: Root
parts.description: The disclosure container. Holds the open state and provides context to the trigger and panel.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state. Two-way by default — use `bind:open`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state, for when `open` is not supplied.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `open` and
only reports through `onOpenChange`, so the parent can reject a change by not
flowing the new value back down. Off by default, because `bind:open` — the common
case — needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the user toggles the panel.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents the trigger from toggling the panel.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element and used to derive the trigger and panel ids. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered root element.

props.name: context
props.description: Bindable handle exposing the collapsible state (`isOpen`, `isDisabled`) and the `setOpen` / `toggle` actions.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is open.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The toggle button. Shows and hides the panel via native button activation.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is open.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: The content shown and hidden by the trigger. Hidden and inert while collapsed.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the closed panel mounted (hidden) instead of unmounting it after the exit animation.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-closed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is closed (with `forceMount` or during the exit transition).

dataAttributes.name: data-collapsible-panel-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the inner content wrapper used for height measurement.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for one frame as the panel starts closing, for exit transitions.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for one frame as the panel starts opening, for enter transitions.
